scope: All official catalog extension repositories, upstream Spec Kit, and all four public speckit-community repositories
method: Recursive default-branch tree inventory and automated scan of discovered workflows/maintenance documents, with selective deeper review; no remote code execution
limitations: Tree SHAs are tree snapshots, not commit SHAs.
Default branches can move between inventory and document reads.
Text fingerprints normalize transport line endings and are not Git blob IDs.
Workflow presence does not prove CI execution, success, or protection enforcement.
Unlisted extension repositories are outside this enumerated scope.
